text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Introducing a MemGPT‑style hierarchical memory system (external store with in‑context paging) will let the rewrite‑based agent stay within the token budget while keeping its ~9 F1 advantage over naive append, directly addressing Reviewer 2’s request for an ablation that isolates the rewrite effect.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["c0fbabea","5f5331d2","f167ace6","f327063e"],"tags":["rewrite","memory‑management","token‑budget","review"]},{"statement":"Periodically consolidating the rewritten memory into compressed summaries—similar to the consolidation techniques described in recent arXiv papers—reduces cross‑fact interference, which explains the ~9 F1 gain of rewrite over append observed in the ablation study.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["c0fbabea","579b3852","03c1d4c1"],"tags":["consolidation","interference","performance"]}]}
